papers.name: Paper 1 Listening
papers.materials: Multiple choice answer sheet; soft pencil; soft clean eraser.
instructions: There are six exercises. Answer all questions.
You will hear each recording twice. Read the questions while you wait.
Mark one letter for each question, except in the final exercise, where you mark two letters for each question.
At the end you have 6 minutes to transfer your answers.
information: The total mark for this paper is 40.
Each correct answer scores one mark.
The paper lasts about 50 minutes, including 6 minutes' transfer time.
advice: Use the reading time to predict what you will hear.
Many correct answers paraphrase what is said: listen for meaning, not for the same words.

papers.name: Paper 2 Reading
instructions: Write your answer to each question in the space provided.
Where a question asks for an answer in Spanish, write in Spanish.
information: The total mark for this paper is 45.
The number of marks for each question or part question is shown in brackets [ ].
advice: The questions follow the order of the text.
Keep written answers short and precise; copying whole sentences can add wrong information.
Answers about another person need the third person (él/ella), not 'yo'.

papers.name: Paper 3 Speaking
papers.materials: Candidate card. 10 minutes' preparation time (no notes).
instructions: Answer all questions. You must respond in Spanish.
You have 10 minutes to prepare the role play on your candidate card. You may not make notes.
The test has a role play (about 2 minutes) and two topic conversations (4 minutes each).
information: The total mark for this test is 40: role play 10, topic conversations 30.
The role play is marked out of 2 for each of five tasks.
The two conversations are marked together: Communication 15, Quality of Language 15.
advice: In the role play a short, accurate answer gets full marks: listen for the tense of each question.
In the conversations, give opinions and reasons and use past, present and future time frames.

papers.name: Paper 4 Writing
instructions: Answer three questions: Question 1, Question 2 and one task for Question 3.
Write your answers in Spanish in the spaces provided.
information: The total mark for this paper is 45.
The number of marks for each question or part question is shown in brackets [ ].
advice: Answer every bullet point, in the tense the bullet uses.
Keep to the word counts: 80-90 words for Question 2 and 130-140 words for Question 3.

qtypes.label: Listening: short recordings, picture choice
qtypes.description: Eight one-line exchanges in a single everyday setting; choose the picture (A-D) that matches the key word.

qtypes.label: Listening: announcement, multiple choice
qtypes.description: A short public announcement or guide's talk with a pause; six A-D items on facts, times, places and rules.

qtypes.label: Listening: match speakers to statements
qtypes.description: Five young people speak in turn; match each to one of six paraphrased statements (one is not needed).

qtypes.label: Listening: two-part interview (A-C)
qtypes.description: A longer interview in two parts; nine three-option items on information, opinions and reasons.

qtypes.label: Listening: interview (A-D)
qtypes.description: An interview with a pause; six four-option items testing detail, explanation and attitude.

qtypes.label: Listening: choose two statements
qtypes.description: An interview heard in three sections; in each, choose the two true statements from five (2 marks each).

qtypes.label: Reading: match sentences to pictures
qtypes.description: Five short sentences; choose the matching picture from six (A-F).

qtypes.label: Reading: signs and notices
qtypes.description: Eight public signs in one setting; match five sentences that paraphrase what someone wants or must do.

qtypes.label: Reading: message or e-mail, multiple choice
qtypes.description: A personal e-mail or message (about 150-180 words); seven three-option items.

qtypes.label: Reading: text with short answers in Spanish
qtypes.description: A first-person blog or account (about 220-260 words); short answers in Spanish, changing person and tense.

qtypes.label: Reading: match people to adverts
qtypes.description: Five people describe what they need; choose the best of eight adverts for each (three are not needed).

qtypes.label: Reading: article with short answers in Spanish
qtypes.description: A longer journalistic interview article (about 280-340 words); answers in Spanish, inference and manipulation.

qtypes.label: Speaking: role play
qtypes.description: Candidate card with a scenario; five teacher questions (one past, one future/conditional), 2 marks each.

qtypes.label: Speaking: two topic conversations
qtypes.description: Two 4-minute conversations (one from areas A/B, one from C/D/E), five scripted questions each with alternatives; Communication 15 + Quality of Language 15.

qtypes.label: Writing: complete a form
qtypes.description: Fill five gaps in a form with single words or short phrases in Spanish.

qtypes.label: Writing: 80-90 words
qtypes.description: Four bullet prompts (five tasks); one levels grid out of 12.

qtypes.label: Writing: 130-140 words
qtypes.description: E-mail, blog or article with five bullet prompts across time frames; Task completion 10, Range 10, Accuracy 8.
